name: Kitashinagawa
tagline: Shinagawa in 2 minutes and Tokyo in 16 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥140,000 to ¥150,000.
summary: The station is in Shinagawa City, where Keikyu run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 22 minutes to Otemachi, 33 minutes to Shinjuku, 28 minutes to Shibuya and 2 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥140,000 to ¥150,000. The station stands 9 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 16.9 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 9 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 1.9 m to 18.8 m, a difference of 16.9 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 4 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 3 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 7 clinics and 5 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 河野臨牀医学研究所附属第三北品川病院, about 3 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 河野臨牀医学研究所附属北品川病院, about 5 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Keikyu Main Line.
congestion: Keikyu Main Line runs at 120% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 戸部→横浜, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥140,000 to ¥150,000 and 1K ¥120,000 to ¥130,000. 1LDK ¥230,000 to ¥240,000 and 2LDK ¥380,000 to ¥390,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥140,000 to ¥150,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the high side. For One room, 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Shimbamba is ahead on lower rent and safety.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Kitashinagawa. It is served by the same lines as Kitashinagawa. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. A one-room flat costs about ¥28,000 less at Shimbamba. On what it offers families, Shimbamba comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: For rail connections, Shinagawa; for lower rent, Kitashinagawa.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Kitashinagawa. Shinagawa has 5 lines that Kitashinagawa does not. With more lines, Shinagawa is the better connected of the two. To Toranomon, for instance, Shinagawa is 7 minutes quicker. A one-room flat, though, costs about ¥10,000 more at Shinagawa.

noiseSources: 第一京浜 (3 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 4 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Keikyu Main Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are very lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
